activeRecallQuiz.scenario: At 2:00 PM, the Industrial Index crosses its old peak on low volume, while the Transport Index stays 2% below its peak. By 3:30 PM, Industrials close below the peak. Did Dow Theory give a buy signal?
activeRecallQuiz.question: At 2:00 PM, the Industrial Index crosses its old peak on low volume, while the Transport Index stays 2% below its peak. By 3:30 PM, Industrials close below the peak. Did Dow Theory give a buy signal?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: No — Triple Rejection! 1) Transport failed to confirm. 2) Intraday 2:00 PM spikes don't count; the 3:30 PM close failed. 3) Low volume warned of weak conviction.
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Applying grounded principles prevents catastrophic losses and capital depletion.

coreTakeaways: Always evaluate underlying market assumptions before entering positions.
Separate gross theoretical payoff from real-world net profit.
Follow disciplined risk and position sizing limits on every trade.
